summary: Implemented a read-only Operational Readiness Dashboard that aggregates existing Mission Control, validation metrics, worker runtime, autonomous operations, notification, Steward presence, and Operations Board artifacts; reports healthy, degraded, blocked, and startup readiness states; preserves drill-down links; and treats missing artifacts as unavailable rather than fatal errors.
known_limitations: The dashboard is intentionally advisory/read-only and depends on source artifacts being generated by their authoritative subsystems; missing source artifacts are reported as unavailable.
Runtime JSON output is generated locally at runtime/operations/operational_readiness_dashboard.json and is not committed when runtime outputs are ignored by repository policy.
